justify-items: center centers the item along the inline axis inside its 100px area; align-items: center centers it along the block axis inside its 60px area. justify-content: start and align-content: start keep that track group at the container’s start. Here horizontal writing and LTR make inline start the left edge.

Use items alignment for cards inside cells; use content alignment for a compact grid inside a larger panel. Fixed tracks leave free space in this fixture; expanding fractional tracks may leave no space for content distribution.

after: A grid item sits inside a grid area. You can move the item within that area. You can also move the rows and columns together inside a larger container.
In this left-to-right page, `justify-items: center` centers the item from left to right. `align-items: center` centers it from top to bottom. Both act inside the item's grid area.
`justify-content` moves the columns together. Changing it from `start` to `end` puts this 100-pixel column at the right of the 240-pixel container. The item stays centered inside it.
Moving the grid needs spare space around its rows or columns. If the columns already fill the container, there is no spare width to move into.
Center the item inside its area. Keep the rows and columns at the top-left of the container.
